column1: Table 1. HM Revenue and Customs Receipts (Monthly)
This table includes monthly data on all taxes administered by HMRC. Receipts are on a cash basis and represent when HMRC received a payment for a taxable event. Figures are presented in £ million.
The table also includes data on amounts paid over into the Consolidated Fund and National Insurance Fund: the latter excludes Northern Ireland.
The corresponding Office for National Statistics identifier codes can be found in the Quality Report: HMRC Receipts.
